messages.content: The Hampton Roads client confirmed the Thursday morning operator session. So this is definitely three hotel nights now. Before I let them lock the timing, compare the Norfolk plan against Richmond one more time.

Then I would stop treating Wednesday night as optional. Best fit is still Norfolk into ORF with hotel Mar. 9-12. The Delta SFO-ATL-ORF itinerary arriving about 8:02 p.m. Monday is the cleaner airport plan because it puts you within a normal drive of the plant and keeps Tuesday usable. Richmond is acceptable only as a disruption backup; the flight may look tidy, but the added drive creates more ways to be late for Wednesday.
What exactly is the Richmond penalty? I do not care about airline here if the schedule is better.

The better Richmond option gets you into RIC early evening, but then you are still looking at roughly 90-110 minutes to the Harbour View or Chesapeake side in good traffic. If you stay near Richmond, the Wednesday 6:30 a.m. plant access becomes a very early highway drive. ORF also has a one-connection routing, so Richmond does not buy enough reliability to offset the ground risk.
Okay. Is the Monday Norfolk arrival too late? I do not want to land tired and then be sloppy for the Tuesday noon pre-walk.

It is late but workable. With an 8:02 p.m. ORF arrival, you should have the car around 8:35 and be at the Chesapeake/Suffolk hotel around 9:10-9:25. Tuesday noon gives you a cushion. I would avoid any plan that arrives after 9 p.m. or pushes the first arrival to Tuesday morning.
Hotel decision then: the Chesapeake HGI keeps the Wednesday drive short. The Norfolk option is better for dinner. Which one should I use now that Thursday is added?

Use the Chesapeake/Suffolk Harbour View hotel. For the 6:30 a.m. Wednesday access, it is the safer location by a lot: likely 20-30 minutes to the gate versus 45-60 from downtown Norfolk if tunnel or bridge traffic is ugly. Norfolk is a nicer dining base, but it is the wrong trade-off for the early plant morning.
I do not want a dead business park with only a pantry. What is around the HGI?

It is not downtown, but it is not stranded. The HGI has a small on-site restaurant/bar when operating, and there are casual dinner options within a short drive around Harbour View and College Drive. Greenbrier has a bigger restaurant cluster, but it adds more morning drive. Current HGI listing is showing solid guest feedback and a refundable rate, so it stays the best fit.
Good. I also need the Thursday return to leave after lunch. Do not put me on an 11 a.m. flight if the operators run long.

Agreed. The Thursday morning branch should be dropped. If the operator session ends around 11:30, the workable return is an ORF departure after about 2:30 p.m., with one connection back to SFO. That gives time to get back to the airport, return the rental car, and avoid rushing. If they warn that it may go past noon, the backup is a later afternoon connection with a much later SFO arrival.
They are saying 11:30 is realistic, final confirmation tomorrow. Put this in as the working plan.

Working plan: fly into ORF, not RIC; arrive Monday Mar. 9 on the Delta one-stop via Atlanta; stay three nights at Hilton Garden Inn Chesapeake/Suffolk Harbour View, Mar. 9-12; use the Thursday afternoon ORF return after 2:30 p.m. if the session is confirmed to end before lunch. Richmond airport and the Norfolk hotel stay as backups only. I will wait for tomorrow’s final timing before booking.
